'''Christopher Jaroniec''' is an American professor of [[Analytical chemistry|analytical]], [[Physical chemistry|physical]], [[chemical physics]] and [[biochemistry]].

==Education==
He obtained his [[Bachelor of Science]] degree in [[chemistry]] from [[Kent State University]] in 1997 and six years got his Ph.D. in physical chemistry from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]]. He is graduate research [[fellow]] of [[National Science Foundation]] and is [[Damon Runyon Cancer Research Foundation]] postdoc fellow.

==Career==
In 2006, Jaroniec became an assistant professor at the [[Ohio State University]] and by 2014 became a full professor.

Currently he works at Evans Laboratory where he was also named ''Evans Scholar'' and is a recipient of such awards as the ''[[Eli Lilly]] Young Investigator Award'' for his analytical chemistry research and ''[[Camille Dreyfus Teacher-Scholar Awards|Camille Dreyfus Teacher-Scholar Award]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://chemistry.osu.edu/~jaroniec/jaroniec2.html|title=Christopher Jaroniec|publisher=Ohio State University|accessdate=February 6, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111104125944/http://chemistry.osu.edu/~jaroniec/jaroniec2.html|archive-date=November 4, 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2007, he was awarded ''New Investigator Research Grant Award'' from the [[Alzheimer's Association]] and an undergraduate award in 1996 from the [[American Chemical Society]]. In 1994, he was awarded freshman award from [[CRC Press]] of Kent State University and the same year became a recipient of the Merck Award from the same place. He also has over 2,200 citations of his numerous [[peer review]]ed articles which were published in such journals as ''[[Biochemistry (journal)|Biochemistry]]'', ''[[Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America]]'' and many others with an [[h-index]] of 37.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://chemistry.osu.edu/~jaroniec/pdf/jaroniec_cv.pdf|title=Christopher Jaroniec|publisher=Ohio State University|accessdate=February 6, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160310183042/http://chemistry.osu.edu/~jaroniec/pdf/jaroniec_cv.pdf|archive-date=March 10, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
